name: Coffer
author: nuu-maan
description: Coffer's capture queue in the Omarchy bar. See what is still open, stash a selection or clip a region without leaving what you are doing.

barWidget.description: Open items in the Coffer capture queue

schema.label: Hide the icon when the queue is empty
schema.description: Keep the bar icon out of the way until something is stashed. Left off, the icon stays put and dims instead.

schema.label: Items shown in the panel
schema.description: How many open items the panel lists before it stops and says how many more there are. The bar count is always the full number.
